attributes.scope: TOOL lane (owns tools/gdl + memory_graph surfaces this run; no other lane touches them): run-34 amendment queue, one commit per item, criticisms cited. (1) probe --arbitrate: one call builds BOTH baseline and edited states and prints the (real, fuzzy) pair for each (MV measured ~4 extra builds per fuzzy/real disagreement without it). (2) probe snapshot semantics: bank a baseline ONLY from a clean-vs-HEAD state, or warn loudly when banking an edited state (MV's second probe banked a neutral edited state, so --revert restored the BAD state). (3) revert completeness: after per-function --revert, cross-check git diff --numstat for the TU + its headers and warn 'edits outside <fn> remain' (MV's volatile-in-macro edit was invisible to per-function revert and stayed live). (4) CONFLICT hard gate: when probe prints CONFLICT it must refuse to classify an outcome until a fresh --fuzzy result exists (PC skipped the mandated arbiter and recorded a false regression). (5) unabsorbed.py: residual-CLASS annotation per row (source-structural vs allocator vs schedule) - MV showed an identical count of 4 hid the class moving from ineligible to eligible. (6) gdlmem stale: a record whose anchor file path no longer exists in the tree is flagged as a REOPEN candidate (MV found an accepted PlayVQMovie record anchored to the deleted movieplayer.c describing a layout the tree no longer produces). (7) proposal gate: warn when an attempt's hypothesis carries a cheapest_refuting_observation that does not mention the hypothesis' own mechanism terms (CI: a mandatory-step-1 hypothesis shipped with a refuter that could never refute it). (8) wf_rederive_pin --transient mode: bank the pre-probe pin hashes, auto-apply re-derived ones for a throwaway A/B, restore banked hashes on probe --revert (GW measured ~2 of 15 probe cycles as pure pin plumbing even after T4's --apply). (9) AGENTS.md Mandatory result policy: add the WF lesson - commissioning a postprocessor capability requires a demand census FIRST (query capability_needed / refusal corpus for customers; run 34 built a sound capability with zero customers). Scoped memory_graph test classes between items, FULL suites green at each commit; ninja 'main.dol: OK' at close; expected verdict changes stated; parallel fleets please pick other TUs
